description: This file defines an Express middleware function 'extractOrganization' that extracts an organization identifier from incoming HTTP requests, attaches it to the request object, and sets up helper functions for scoping and filtering based on organization/tenant IDs. It handles super admin bypass scenarios and prioritizes headers over query parameters and request body.

methods.name: extractOrganization
methods.description: Middleware function that extracts organization ID from request headers, query, or body, handles super admin bypass, and sets up request helpers for scoping.
